data.name: CORRUPT.EXE
data.detailed_description:
THE SYSTEM REMEMBERS YOU.

You are not the hero. You are an intrusion — a strain of malware loose inside a hostile machine, and the antivirus is learning. It profiles your movement, predicts your dodges, adapts its pursuit mid-run, and carries everything it learned about you into the next one. Every run, the system knows you a little better. Every run, you have to become something it hasn't seen.

INFECT. Choose your strain — the regenerating WORM, the life-leeching TROJAN, the greedy RANSOM, the untouchable GHOST, or the walking apocalypse LOGIC.BMB — and carve through endless waves of security processes, each generation procedurally mutated.

EVOLVE. Fifteen weapons, each with five levels and an evolved form. Then it gets stupid: fuse two evolved abilities into one of 225 fusion combinations, each with its own name, color, and quirk. Fuse two primed fusions and ascend to the OMEGA tier — if you can survive long enough to build one.

SURVIVE THE PURGE. Boss-class defense programs hunt you every five minutes — a ravenous snake that rages when it feeds, a corrupted DVD logo that locks you in the arena, a blackout that swallows the screen whole. Kill the third and choose: extract with your stolen DATA, or go endless and see how deep the system goes. The fast and the bold will find things hiding past the fifteen-minute mark that we won't spoil here.

FEATURES

  • An adaptive AI director that profiles your playstyle and persists between runs

  • 15 weapons → evolutions → 225 fusions → OMEGA fusions

  • 5 virus strains with unique passives, permanent upgrades, and a fusion codex to fill

  • Dimension rifts: first-person 3D maze raids for high-value loot, mid-run

  • Secret bosses, warp gates, a black hole, and a 0.5% mythic jackpot someone will clip

  • CRT arcade mode, colorblind assist filters, full neon-on-black synth aesthetic

You have one job: don't get deleted.

data.short_description: CORRUPT.EXE is a neon roguelite where you play the malware. Swarm-survival action with evolving weapons, a 225-combo fusion system, and an adaptive antivirus that profiles your movement, learns your habits, and hunts you smarter every run. Infect. Evolve. Extract — or go endless.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Headphones recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended
